lead: Maritana Resources dominated the window with a 62% jump in the Burbanks Gold Project Mineral Resource to 755koz, lifting the company's group-wide total above 2.1Moz and pointing to a further update and Ore Reserve studies ahead.
subtitle: Burbanks resource growth headlines a day otherwise led by drilling updates and Anson's Utah tax credit stack.
subject: MRT lifts Burbanks resource 62% to 755koz, group tops 2.1Moz

item: Alchemy Resources: RC drilling results at Yellow Mountain and Overflow expected in due course
day_in_brief:
Resources and reserves: Maritana Resources' updated Burbanks Mineral Resource rose 62% to 13.7Mt at 1.7g/t Au for 755koz, driven by Burbanks North's growth to 11.1Mt at 1.47g/t Au for 523koz, taking group-wide resources past 2.1Moz. Black Cat Syndicate reported RC drilling at Trojan extending mineralisation beyond the existing 202koz @ 1.1g/t Au Resource in both the northern down-dip and southeastern oxide zones, with best results of 3m @ 6.88g/t Au from 142m and 7m @ 3.02g/t Au from 257m.

Drilling: Alchemy Resources began RC drilling at its Yellow Mountain and Overflow project in NSW, testing extensions of prior high-grade copper-gold intercepts including 113m @ 1.17% CuEq and 31m @ 1.54% CuEq, alongside the 342koz AuEq Overflow resource. Stavely Minerals used the Resources Rising Stars conference to recap its Thursday's Gossan scoping study economics (A$818 million pre-tax NPV, 40% IRR, 60Mt at 0.58% CuEq) without new drilling or financial disclosures.

Corporate and funding: Anson Resources secured a second Utah incentive, a post-performance tax credit of approximately A$212 million, taking combined state incentives for the Green River Lithium Project to US$406,514,271 (A$569,119,979), with the financial impact to be assessed in the Green River DFS. Manhattan Gold entered a trading halt pending a material capital raising announcement, expected to resume by 15 September 2026 or the announcement, whichever comes first. American Uranium completed its A$1.235 million Convertible Loan Note raising to fund Lo Herma ISR Uranium Project studies, with a general meeting to follow on facility approvals and a further A$1.3 million note tranche.

Quarterlies: Six recurring filings were lodged, including Gilgama Resources' DFS economics and Hawthorn Resources' maiden Lincoln JORC estimate of 2.46Mt at 5.1g/t Au for 402koz, alongside half-year losses from Galan Lithium subsidiaries, Sunstone Metals, Tesoro Resources and Alvo Minerals.

summaries.heading: Extensional drilling extends Trojan mineralised footprint
summaries.body: Black Cat's 56-hole RC program at the 100%-owned Trojan deposit, part of Kal East, intersected mineralisation beyond the current 202koz @ 1.1g/t Au Resource in both the northern down-dip zone and the southeastern flat-lying oxide zone. Best results included 3m @ 6.88g/t Au from 142m (26TRRC008A) and 7m @ 3.02g/t Au from 257m (26TRRC010A). Further extensional and infill drilling is planned to support a Resource upgrade and updated life of mine planning.

summaries.heading: Burbanks resource jumps 62% to 755koz, group total tops 2.1Moz
summaries.body: Maritana's updated Burbanks Gold Project Mineral Resource has grown to 13.7Mt at 1.7g/t Au for 755koz, up 290koz from the prior 6.1Mt at 2.4g/t Au for 466koz estimate, lifting company-wide resources above 2.1Moz. Growth was driven almost entirely by Burbanks North, now 11.1Mt at 1.47g/t Au for 523koz, with the Indicated component rising to 29%. Remaining Phase 2 assays are due in the September quarter 2026, ahead of a further resource update in the December quarter 2026 and follow-on Ore Reserve studies.

summaries.heading: Stavely presents Thursday's Gossan story at Rising Stars
summaries.body: Stavely Minerals used the Resources Rising Stars conference to recap its Thursday's Gossan scoping study, including a pre-tax NPV of A$818 million, 40% IRR and 60Mt at 0.58% CuEq resource, alongside Freddy's Find gold-silver results. No new drilling or financial data was disclosed. Next catalysts remain further Freddy's Find and Junction drilling and assessment of development options.

summaries.heading: Anson secures further A$212 million Utah tax credit
summaries.body: Utah's Governor's Office of Economic Development has approved a post-performance tax credit of approximately A$212 million for the Green River Lithium Project, under the REDTIF program, equal to 50% of projected state tax revenue of approximately A$425 million over 20 years. Combined with the earlier Utah Inland Port Authority rebate, total incentives now stand at US$406,514,271 (A$569,119,979). The financial impact will be assessed in the Green River Definitive Feasibility Study.

summaries.heading: Anson secures second Utah tax credit, combined incentives top A$569 million
summaries.body: Utah's Governor's Office of Economic Development has approved a post-performance tax credit of approximately A$212 million for the Green River Lithium Project, under the REDTIF program based on projected state tax revenue of approximately A$425 million over 20 years. Combined with the earlier Utah Inland Port Authority rebate, total incentives now stand at US$406,514,271 (A$569,119,979). The financial impact will be assessed in the Green River Definitive Feasibility Study.

summaries.heading: Alchemy starts RC drilling at NSW gold-copper targets
summaries.body: Alchemy Resources has commenced RC drilling at its 80%-owned Yellow Mountain and Overflow project in NSW, with up to 15 holes planned. Yellow Mountain will test the northern extension of 2025 intercepts of 113m @ 1.17% CuEq (YMRC004) and 31m @ 1.54% CuEq (YMRC005), plus two IP-defined targets including a 750m anomaly east of prior drilling. Overflow drilling targets high-grade gold shoots and the northern extension of the existing 342koz AuEq resource beneath shallow cover. Results are expected in due course.

summaries.heading: Manhattan Gold halted ahead of material capital raising
summaries.body: Manhattan Gold has entered a voluntary trading halt pending an announcement on a material capital raising. Trading is expected to remain suspended until the earlier of the raising announcement or the start of trading on 15 September 2026. The halt follows last week's Jaws drilling results.

summaries.heading: American Uranium completes A$1.235 million loan note raising
summaries.body: American Uranium has received funds and issued Convertible Loan Notes under its previously announced A$1.235 million Facility, supporting the Lo Herma ISR Uranium Project's Scoping Study and permitting work. A general meeting will be convened to approve the Facility Options, shares issued in lieu of interest, and a further A$1.3 million of Convertible Loan Notes on similar terms.
